Sample.evidence_source: [page/9/Text/8] The first aim was to test whether a brief CB depression prevention program would outperform an assessment-only control group. Results indicated that this brief CB intervention produced significantly greater reductions in depressive symptoms than observed in assessment-only controls at posttest and 6-month follow-up and that these changes were clinically significant.
